data.reasoning: The package is a standard VCS icon theme package with no malicious code in the PKGBUILD. The only disagreement stems from a transient API error in the qwen model that prevented it from reviewing .SRCINFO and .gitignore, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and correctly determined the package is safe.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model failed with HTTP 400 errors on .SRCINFO and .gitignore, forcing an inconclusive result. The deepseek model processed all files successfully and found no issues. The openrouter report is advisory only and does not count as a vote.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO and .gitignore due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic for transient LLM API errors to avoid failing the entire audit when non-executable metadata files fail to process.

When a tool error causes an inconclusive verdict on non-executable files (.SRCINFO, .gitignore) but the PKGBUILD is already verified as safe, the system could gracefully degrade to a safe verdict rather than blocking the user.
